root_cause_label: Correct Code Fix but No Successful Distribution Rebuild — Maven Network Failures Blocked Build Artifact Production
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly implemented a filename sanitization fix in FileUploadHandler.java but declared task completion without a successful distribution rebuild, after Maven dependency downloads repeatedly failed due to a network-unreachable environment.
t_err_evidence: mvn compile -pl flink-runtime -am -DskipTests fails; network unreachable, unresolvable parent POM
t_commit_evidence: Step 59: The agent calls finish() declaring task completion despite explicitly acknowledging in step 58 that the build could not be verified due to network limitations. This premature completion claim locks in the failing outcome as no built distribution artifact exists.
t_surface_evidence: Non-resolvable parent POM: transfer failed for apache-20.pom, Network is unreachable (connect failed)
trigger_explanation: The Maven build environment had no network access to Maven Central and an incomplete local repository cache. The agent correctly identified this as a blocking issue (steps 39-56), made one workaround attempt (manually downloading apache-20.pom in step 50), but did not resolve the full dependency chain (apache-18, maven-bundle-plugin, jackson-bom also failed in step 56). Instead of pursuing additional workarounds or reporting an inability to satisfy the build requirement, the agent claimed completion at step 59.
forewarning_evidence: mvn clean compile fails: Non-resolvable parent POM, Network is unreachable (connect failed)
